scope: new 18/22 flow; preserve sealed 08:30 runtime and old observations as archive; no reuse of 05:00 night-close features
window_rule: both actual information cutoff and actual saved time in the same window, inclusive exact endpoints; publish after window is unqualified; no backdating
clock_alignment: minute bars completed by actual cutoff; exact HH:MM historical alignment per model artifact; 18 and22 trained/calibrated separately; nonmatching clock uses M0; NY timezone DST/EST recorded every time
roles_rule: first qualified18 is formal; first qualified22 revises qualified18, otherwise supplement; all additional updates retained separately; unqualified does not consume formal slot
anchor: latest completed official cash T close; T+1..3 from saved official exchange calendar; same anchor for all horizons; never add T+2 change to T+1 forecast
target: strict positive close return is up, negative down; exact-flat outcomes separately recorded and excluded from binary direction/Brier
exact50: no direction; below confidence threshold excluded only from direction hit rate; all nonflat outcomes remain in Brier/log loss

baseline.name: M0 mature history proportion + volatility-scaled empirical distribution
baseline.volatility: max(trailing20 sample standard deviation, trailing60 EWMA root-mean-square log return); computed from prefix only
baseline.distribution: historical h-session log returns divided by each origin sigma*sqrt(h), rescale at current sigma; up/down probability and q10/q50/q90 from one empirical distribution

validation.calibration: positive-slope sigmoid fitted only on past disjoint calibration set, per slot/minute/horizon; DST recorded and subgroup metrics shown
validation.no_pristine_holdout_claim: existing history was opened in prior research; sealed temporal out-of-sample replay is not pristine unseen human data; any new feature needs genuinely unopened/prospective evidence before promotion

quantiles.score: pinball loss in index points; also normalized by anchor
quantiles.coherence: one CDF for direction and price quantiles; reject crossing or contradictory median/interval
quantiles.intranight: use matched-time residual uncertainty, never complete-night05:00 residuals; M0 keeps full future horizon uncertainty without shrinking based on elapsed night
quantiles.one_sided_band: requires >=90% same-distribution tail confidence and historical matched-time calibration support; otherwise fall back to M0

features_policy: all tabs may supply candidates; event available_at<=cutoff and historical vintage proof required; no latest payload backfill; absent value is absent, not zero; seasonal statistics recomputed from dates strictly before origin, no current partial-month final return

release_policy.fallback: display M0 probability/quantiles when matching slot model unavailable or ineligible; explicitly label and do not imply night data influenced M0
release_policy.rolling60: score stored shadow candidate and M0 on same matured qualified cohort; disable when candidate Brier>M0, automatically restore when same-date latest60 improves; formal/supplement/revision scores separate
release_policy.recovery: candidate must remain historically eligible; all source/time/model integrity gates must still pass

forward: 18 formal and22 supplement each counted separately per horizon;22 revisions separately scored, never added as extra formal sample; no unqualified sample in formal60; no accuracy fabricated before maturity
non_overlap: per horizon test origins chronological, predeclared phase0 earliest eligible, next origin>=previous target; same day set for candidate and M0; state n and coverage
refresh: chat publication only; frontend reads saved static JSON; no fetch/train/grade on GET or refresh
